Maya (DevEx): Heads up — planning a 2hr "observability lab" for the SI shadow sprint next Wed 10–12 PT. Goal: give partners hands-on with Redwood Console dashboards, trace hooks, alert triage, and an intentional rollback/debug scenario. Who can help run/demo?
Raj (SI Enablement): I can co-run. propose split: 30m intro + 60m hands-on labs (teams of 2) + 30m debrief/Q&A. Need a short prereq checklist for partners.
Aisha (Partnerships): Agree on format. How many SIs are we targeting? Also need marketplace/legal ok for any demo credentials?
Tom (Solutions): Target 6 partners (3 pairs). For creds: create read-only demo accounts + a sandbox project per partner. OpsBot: calendar invite created for 2026-04-01 17:00 UTC (10:00 PT).
Maya (DevEx): Thanks Raj/Tom. Prereqs: 1) access to demo org, 2) laptop with Python + curl, 3) optional: API key for streaming tests (read-only). I'll draft a one-pager.
Raj (SI Enablement): For hands-on lab, propose two exercises: 1) broken rollout detection — introduce a regression via model variant and have partners find the regression using Console traces/metrics; 2) KV-cache hot path — show how prefix caching impacts latency/cost.
Tom (Solutions): I'll build the broken-rollout script. quick snippet to simulate faulty deploy:
```bash
# deploy a canary that returns malformed responses
curl -X POST https://demo.redwood.ai/deploy -H 'Authorization: Bearer $DEMO' -d '{"variant":"canary-bad","traffic":0.2}'
```
Maya (DevEx): Perfect. Raj — can you bake in a checklist of metrics to watch (latency p50/p95, error-rate, avg tokens per request, rollback events)? I'll add screenshots to the one-pager.
Aisha (Partnerships): I'll coordinate invites and send partner prep email. Volunteers to be boots-on-the-ground during labs? need 3 internal leads.
Tom (Solutions): I'll be lead for exercise 1. Raj — can you take exercise 2?
Raj (SI Enablement): Yup. I'll prepare a short slide deck + a link to the troubleshooting runbook.
Maya (DevEx): Action items: Maya -> one-pager + screenshots (due Fri); Raj -> slides + runbook link (due Mon); Tom -> broken-rollout script + sandbox setup (due Mon); Aisha -> partner invites + vet creds (due Tue). OpsBot: reminder set for 48h before event.
Aisha (Partnerships): Noted. Also want to capture feedback via a 3-question pulse after session. Maya can you add a short survey form?
Maya (DevEx): Yep — will add 3 Qs: usefulness, confidence to repeat, blockers. Link goes in follow-up.
Tom (Solutions): FYI — I'll stash the demo scripts in `repos/si-labs/observability` and share links here when ready.
Raj (SI Enablement): One more ask: can we record the session? Some partners want to rewatch. OpsBot: recording enabled for scheduled meeting.
Maya (DevEx): Great. If no objections, we'll proceed. If anyone wants to run a short preflight rehearsal Thurs AM, ping me. :raised_hands:
Tom (Solutions): I'll join the rehearsal.
Aisha (Partnerships): Thanks all — excited to get partners comfortable with the Console.
